en.p: The derivative $f'(x)$ of a function $f(x)$ differentiable on the set of all real numbers is
For a positive number $a$, let $y=g(x)$ be the equation of the tangent line to the curve $y=f(x)$ at the point $(a,\,f(a))$. When all positive numbers $a$ for which the function
has a local maximum or local minimum at $x=a$ are listed in increasing order, let $a_n$ be the $n$th number. Find the value of $\dfrac{100}{\pi}\times\left(a_6-a_2\right)$. [4 points]
